Rendered documentation is inventoried and hash-bound; its tracked source documents are scanned separately.

tracked_repository.rule: Every Git-tracked path is inventoried. JSON/JSONL/CSV and declared text formats, including Python, shell and JavaScript scripts, are content-scanned. Unsupported binary files require exact path, content SHA-256, reason and explicit coverage disposition; unlisted formats fail closed.

external_execution_locations.coverage_decision: Create a distinct typed REMOTE_HPC review naming the Snellius or other locations/accounts searched, method and time; locally materialize every IN_SCOPE recovered source under declared parsed scan coverage at its indexed SHA-256, explicitly dispose reviewed non-seed sources, or document the evidence-based no-source conclusion.

Create a distinct typed CLOUD review naming every cloud/VM location/account searched, method and time; locally materialize every IN_SCOPE recovered source under declared parsed scan coverage at its indexed SHA-256, explicitly dispose reviewed non-seed sources, or document the evidence-based no-source conclusion.

Create a distinct typed DELETED_LOCAL review naming backups, provenance records and owners searched, method and time; locally materialize every IN_SCOPE recovered source under declared parsed scan coverage at its indexed SHA-256, explicitly dispose reviewed non-seed sources, or document the evidence-based no-recovery conclusion.

Create a distinct typed COLLABORATOR_HELD review naming the collaborators or custodians checked, method and time; locally materialize every IN_SCOPE supplied source under declared parsed scan coverage at its indexed SHA-256, explicitly dispose reviewed non-seed sources, or document the evidence-based no-source conclusion.

outputs.root_scope: Only the explicitly mounted project outputs/ tree; no parent directories, home-directory search, or unrelated private data.
outputs.csv_rule: Inspect every CSV header and parse only files with seed-like columns; files without seed-like columns are inventoried but not content-scanned.

limitations: The mounted outputs tree is not asserted to include deleted, remote, cloud, HPC, or collaborator-held runs; each class has an explicit unresolved coverage decision above.

Raw output JSON files whose basenames do not match the declared metadata patterns are not seed-parsed; many are large repeated candidate records. Each excluded file is nevertheless bound by path, kind, bytes and SHA-256 and requires an exact disposition.

Archives, spreadsheets, PDFs, NPZ files, images, and other binary formats are not opened for seed parsing. Their byte identities remain unresolved unless covered by exact per-file dispositions or one exact whole-index review.
Textual seed mentions, ranges, formulas, and seed-like epidemiological parameter names are never silently converted into RNG seeds.
This inventory does not allocate, recommend, reserve, or authorize any seed block or model execution.
